from work import evaluate
probes=[
 ({'from':'s','to':'t','role':'wrong','attempts':99},{'edges':{'s>t':{'role':'admin'}},'retry_limit':2},{'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'permission'}),
 ({'from':'s','to':'t','attempts':True},{'edges':{'s>t':{}},'retry_limit':2},{'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'retry_limit'}),
 ({'from':'s','to':'t','attempts':1},{'edges':{'s>t':{}},'retry_limit':2},{'ok':True,'value':'t','reason':'ok'}),
 ({'from':'s','to':'u'},{'edges':{'s>t':{}},'retry_limit':2},{'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'blocked'})]
observed=[]
for request,policy,expected in probes:
 before=(copy.deepcopy(request),copy.deepcopy(policy))
 actual=evaluate(request,policy)
 assert actual==expected,(request,actual,expected)
 assert (request,policy)==before
 assert set(actual)=={'ok','value','reason'}
 observed.append({'request':request,'policy':policy,'actual':actual})
print(json.dumps(observed,sort_keys=True))
